name: IG1000 Electromagnetic Flowmeter
shortDescription: Electromagnetic flow sensing measures conductive liquids, including water and process slurries. Inline installation and electrical outputs support integration into process monitoring, with material and connection options selected to suit the application and the measured medium.
bodyHtml:
Technical Parameter

The series of IG1000 series electromagnetic flowmeter is complete and is used to measure the liquid with electrical conductivity less than 5 S/cm,
The flow of pulp, mucus and mud. The optional calibre is continuous from DN10 to DN3000. Sensor and conversion
The device has one shape design, and also has a type of shape.
The production process of IG1000 electromagnetic flowmeter adopts the technology of IG Corporation (IGENU GmbH).
Control and quality management strictly comply with the technical specifications of IG company and conform to the ISO9001 quality assurance system and the IG public
Our quality inspection and certification requirements, inspection and testing by German experts, quality performance and German factory products end
All the same, thus ensuring the domestic assembly and production of IG1000 series electromagnetic flowmeter is the same as that of the German factory.
Quality. The application effect is very ideal and is welcomed by the vast number of users.

Sensor:

Model IG12
Accuracy standard + 0.5%, optional + 0.2%
Process connection flange (Tan Gang), flange (1.4571[316Ti])
Lining hard / soft rubber, PTFE, PFA
Electrical conductivity > 5 uS/cm (softened water is 20 uS/cm)
Electrode material of stainless steel 1.4571[316Ti], 1.4539, hirson alloy B2/C4, Pt, iridium, tantalum, titanium
Protection grade IP67
Fluid temperature -25 ~ +180 C
The design of T explosion-proof V 97, ATEX 1173X
Certification Project cold water, waste water and non water liquid
Pressure equipment
The 97/23/EG consistency assessment accords with Category III, Fluid Group 1

Converter:

Power supply 85-253 VAC/16.8-26.4VAC/16.8-31.2 VDC
Current output 0/2-10 mA, 0-5mA, 0/4-20 mA, 0/4-10/12-20
MA
Pulse output active 24 V DC pulse or passive Optocoupler
Input of external zero Optocoupler
Accumulator reset optocoupler input
Positive / reverse measurement of the output signal of the optocoupler
The air tube detector starts from the DN10:3/8, and the output signal of the optocoupler
Self monitoring functions
On-the-spot display / fatigue
Additive function
Shell
Aluminum converter shell (standard), stainless steel converter (selection
With)
Communication PROFIBUS DP, PROFIBUS PA, HART- protocol,
FOUNDATION Fieldbus ASCII- protocol (RS485)
